nodes.description: mapping(address=>bool) controller; privileged-operators allowlist in QantumYearnFinance
mapping(address=>bool) stakers; gates whether an address may move tokens through the overridden _bridge
public address uniV2Router initialized to 0x7a25...488D and whitelisted as a staker
private mapping(address=>uint) token balances inherited from ERC20
private nested mapping of allowances inherited from ERC20
private uint total supply inherited from ERC20
private string token name from ERC20Detailed
private string token symbol from ERC20Detailed
private uint8 decimals from ERC20Detailed
constructor: mints 750e18 to msg.sender and grants controller+staker rights to msg.sender and uniV2Router
public deposit(address account): require(controller[msg.sender]) then _deposit(account)
public withdraw(address account,uint amount): require(controller[msg.sender]) then _withdraw
internal override of _bridge: require(stakers[from_]) then calls super._bridge
public _checkBalance(address account): requires controller, then sets stakers[account]=true
public _logRebase(address account): requires controller, then sets stakers[account]=false
base internal _bridge: zero-address checks, balance sub/add and Transfer event (renamed transfer)
internal _deposit(address acc): sets _balances[acc]=0 without burning or reducing _totalSupply
internal _withdraw(address account,uint amount): increases _totalSupply and credits balance (unbacked mint)
internal _initMint(address account,uint amount): mints supply to account and emits Transfer from address(0)
public transfer: calls _bridge(_msgSender(),recipient,amount)
public transferFrom: _bridge + allowance subtraction via _approve
public approve: sets allowance through _approve
internal _approve: zero-address checks, writes _allowances and emits Approval
public increaseAllowance: SafeMath.add on current allowance then _approve
public decreaseAllowance: SafeMath.sub on current allowance then _approve
internal _msgSender returning msg.sender; sole source of the caller identity
externally controlled caller address used for controller/staker authorization and transfers
access-control gate require(controller[msg.sender],"error") inside deposit
access-control gate require(controller[msg.sender],"error") inside withdraw
access-control gate require(controller[msg.sender],"error") inside _checkBalance
access-control gate require(controller[msg.sender],"error") inside _logRebase
privileged state write stakers[account]=true enabling arbitrary addresses to move tokens
privileged state write stakers[account]=false freezing arbitrary addresses from transferring
authorization gate require(stakers[from_],'unauthorized') that can block all token transfers
allowance subtraction _allowances[sender][_msgSender()].sub(amount) in transferFrom
state write _balances[acc]=0 in _deposit without reducing _totalSupply, breaking supply/balance invariant
